relations.support_notes: Hidden signature "byang chub grags" (glossed "rgya dmar ba") in one of the closing verses, two lines of which have the same reading as the closing verse of his De kho na nyid don gsal bar byed pa (ID:4599).

comments:
The text is being edited, translated and studied by Pascale Hugon and Kevin Vose ([RH4GCHQB]).
It is a Madhyamaka treatise articulated around the presentation of the two truths, which builds upon and discusses the views of earlier scholars, who are identified in interlinear notes in (ID:4685). They are, notably, rNgog Blo ldan shes rab (ID:3786), Gangs pa She'u (ID:3810), Khyung rin chen grags (ID:3809), as well as Me tig pa (ID:4207) and a yet unidentified "dge bshes pa." See [VA4UYHER].

A (reworked) Tangut version of that treatise is discussed in [E6DFSL9U].
